title: Greedy-deployment advantage-margin objective smoke
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Adding a small advantage-weighted hinge that promotes sampled positive-advantage actions over the current legal greedy action will align learned updates with greedy deployment better than unchanged PPO, without violating sampled-policy behavior accounting or source-KL preservation.
material_change: Add a default-off greedy advantage-margin term to trinal_clip_ppo_update and train_v5. Only positive normalized-advantage rows whose sampled action differs from current legal argmax are eligible. The hinge pushes sampled-action logit above detached current-greedy logit by a fixed margin, weighted by detached positive advantage. Preserve ordinary PPO, entropy, critic, optimizer, sampled rollout, source KL, and all default behavior. Unit-test zero-coef compatibility, eligibility, gradients, legal argmax, metrics, and validation; then run a bounded matched v6 Standard10-rebind smoke before any pilot scale.
baseline: Raw actor, low-LR/parent-KL tails, Standard10 soup, and procedural-domain candidates all failed independent Slumbot confirmation. Sampled PPO league reward and internal greedy anchors have been poorly correlated with external greedy deployment. Prior offline counterfactual soft-policy replay was neutral/negative and is not reused.
source: Standard10 learned checkpoint plus current corrected-v6 sampled PPO trainer

result.summary: Matched default PPO and greedy-advantage-margin arms completed 21,494 physical training hands total; independent audits and 18 tests passed. The auxiliary was active and stable, but 3,072 common-deck greedy mirrored pairs across Standard10, Slumbot-free, and corrected-CFR96 gave pooled treatment-control -0.266 bb/100 with 95% CI [-45.252,44.720] and only1/3 positive anchors.
result.conclusion: A small advantage-weighted hinge can alter greedy-deployed learned logits without breaking PPO accounting, but this smoke provides no positive cross-anchor efficacy evidence. The two most deployment-relevant learned anchors moved negatively, so scale-up or Slumbot allocation is not justified.
result.next_step: Retain the default-off implementation and use the external Standard10 greedy-versus-sampled execution gap plus accumulated negative confirmation evidence to choose a higher-information learned-weight direction; do not revive single-teacher imitation or this margin objective without new evidence.
